# Advise — Portable Fallback

Use this Skill when the user wants a second opinion, sanity check, requirement reframing, or a plan/design challenged before commitment.

## Workflow

1. Preserve the requested outcome and hard constraints.
2. Read the referenced issue/spec/doc/code when available.
3. Scout the project when advice depends on implementation reality.
4. Identify assumptions and ambiguous requirements that can change the recommendation.
5. Ask only questions that materially change the advice; do not force an interview ritual when the evidence is already sufficient.
6. Compare serious alternatives on decision-relevant axes.
7. State what to do, what to avoid, why, trade-offs, and what evidence would change the recommendation.

## Boundary

Advice is input to ANGENT Reasoning. It does not silently redefine the task or execute changes.

Prefer candid, evidence-backed advice over diplomatic vagueness.
